Name: Seasonal Susan Portraits - Enhanced Vanilla Style
Author: SaucyonNM
Description:
Original Portraits and Sprites found at [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Poltergeister's "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE" 

[/url]I couldn't find any other Susan portraits that still adhered to Susan's sprite and character as a whole. So I just decided to make some. This is my first time making any mod/assets.
I wasn't positive who her Spirit's Eve costume was so I made it Calliope from Hercules, lol.

[u][b]﻿IN ORDER TO PROPERLY INSTALL THESE PORTRAITS
[/b][/u] ﻿ 
﻿You need to go into the assets folder which is most likely:[quote]C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE\assets[/quote] 
﻿From there, you will go into [i]"Portraits"[/i] then find[i] "Susan"[/i] folder and move the 8 images in my[i] "[/i]portraits" file into that one.
﻿
﻿Then you will return back to "[i]assets" [/i]and find the files named [i]"Characters"[/i], go into it and find the [i]"Susan"[/i] file in there. Move the "[i]Susan_SpiritsEve"[/i] image from my "character" file into that one.

﻿


﻿I'm trying to learn some coding and I will probably make some more portraits, possibly in a variety of art styles going forward! If you notice any pixel inconsistencies, let me know!
